api/shared/app_build_errors.py.name: App build memory errors
api/shared/app_build_errors.py.description: Explains clearly when an app build runs out of memory, so builders see what went wrong instead of a silent crash.

api/shared/app_sdk_upgrade_settings.py.name: Automatic app upgrades
api/shared/app_sdk_upgrade_settings.py.description: Stores the platform-wide choice about whether apps are rebuilt onto the latest app toolkit automatically.

api/shared/application_sdk_upgrades.py.name: App toolkit upgrades
api/shared/application_sdk_upgrades.py.description: Queues app rebuilds onto the latest app toolkit, one at a time per app, and skips any app already mid-change.

api/shared/artifact_generation.py.name: Document and file makers
api/shared/artifact_generation.py.description: Turns a described document, spreadsheet or text file into a real downloadable file that chats and workflows can hand to people.

api/shared/artifact_preview.py.name: Office file previews
api/shared/artifact_preview.py.description: Shows a safe preview of a Word or Excel file in the browser without running anything hidden inside it.

api/shared/audit_aggregation.py.name: Access log summaries
api/shared/audit_aggregation.py.description: Summarises who checked what access over fixed time windows, and lets an administrator drill into the records behind each count.

api/shared/builtin_roles.py.name: Built-in roles
api/shared/builtin_roles.py.description: Defines the standard roles every workspace starts with, so new customers have workable permissions from day one.

api/shared/chat_context.py.name: Chat size tracking
api/shared/chat_context.py.description: Records how large each chat request was, kept apart from the usage totals customers are billed against.

api/shared/cli_artifact.py.name: Command-line tool package
api/shared/cli_artifact.py.description: Builds the downloadable command-line tool that matches the running platform, so it installs and works first time.

api/shared/contract_version.py.name: Compatibility marker
api/shared/contract_version.py.description: Marks which older command-line tools this platform still accepts, so upgrades do not break existing setups.

api/shared/device_auth.py.name: Device sign-in approval
api/shared/device_auth.py.description: Records a person's yes or no to a sign-in request from another device once, without extending how long the request stays open.

api/shared/export_import.py.name: Workspace export and import
api/shared/export_import.py.description: Copies knowledge, tables, settings and connected services out of one workspace and into another, respecting who may see what.

api/shared/form_captcha.py.name: Public form bot protection
api/shared/form_captcha.py.description: Asks anonymous form visitors to solve a small computing puzzle so automated spam cannot flood public forms.

api/shared/form_execution.py.name: Form run context
api/shared/form_execution.py.description: Starts the work behind a submitted form as the form itself, never as the person who filled it in or embedded it.

api/shared/form_provider.py.name: Form field choices
api/shared/form_provider.py.description: Fills in a form's dropdown or lookup options by running only the data source the form author attached to that field.

api/shared/form_publication.py.name: Public form review
api/shared/form_publication.py.description: Shows exactly what becomes visible to the public before a form is published, so nothing is shared by accident.

api/shared/form_runtime.py.name: Form submission rules
api/shared/form_runtime.py.description: Checks submitted form answers and uploads against the published form, and refuses duplicates and tampered values.

api/shared/home.py.name: Home page and collections
api/shared/home.py.description: Builds each person's home page and pinned collections, showing only the apps, forms and tables they may see.

api/shared/identities.py.name: Unattended identities
api/shared/identities.py.description: Provides the named stand-ins that run scheduled work when no person is present, and blocks them from ever signing in.

api/shared/logo_processing.py.name: Logo cleanup
api/shared/logo_processing.py.description: Checks an uploaded logo and makes a clean square thumbnail so workspace branding looks right everywhere.

api/shared/models.py.name: Shared request and reply shapes
api/shared/models.py.description: Holds the shared definitions of what the platform sends and receives where no single area owns them.

api/shared/path_glob.py.name: File pattern matching
api/shared/path_glob.py.description: Matches file paths the way developers expect from wildcard patterns, so source search finds the right files.

api/shared/path_matching.py.name: Folder containment checks
api/shared/path_matching.py.description: Answers whether a file sits inside a given folder, so folder-based permission rules agree everywhere.

api/shared/policy_rules.py.name: Shared permission rules
api/shared/policy_rules.py.description: Finds where a named permission rule is used and resolves shared rules into the policies that rely on them.

api/shared/schema_gate.py.name: Startup safety gate
api/shared/schema_gate.py.description: Holds background processes until the database has caught up with this release, so nothing runs against an outdated structure.

api/shared/solution_deploy_status.py.name: Solution install progress
api/shared/solution_deploy_status.py.description: Reports how far a Solution install or update has got, reading it from the platform's standard long-running job record.

api/shared/solution_dev.py.name: Local Solution preview
api/shared/solution_dev.py.description: Lets a permitted builder preview a Solution app on their own machine using a short-lived pass tied to their account.

api/shared/svg_sanitizer.py.name: Image safety check
api/shared/svg_sanitizer.py.description: Strips anything dangerous out of uploaded vector images before they are stored or shown to anyone.

api/shared/table_batch_writes.py.name: Bulk table writes
api/shared/table_batch_writes.py.description: Adds or changes many table entries at once, refusing the whole batch if a permission check or duplicate would break it.

api/shared/table_document_writes.py.name: Table entry changes
api/shared/table_document_writes.py.description: Creates, edits and deletes table entries, checking the person may change both the old and the new version.

api/shared/table_documents.py.name: Table entry reads
api/shared/table_documents.py.description: Finds and returns table entries, hiding any record the person is not allowed to read.

api/shared/table_resolution.py.name: Finding the right table
api/shared/table_resolution.py.description: Works out which table a name or reference means for this person, and refuses anything outside their reach.

api/shared/version.py.name: Version number
api/shared/version.py.description: Reports which version of the platform is running, so support and updates can tell builds apart.
